description: Make a link page, or change one: a public page at the app’s address followed by /@handle, with the user’s name, one line about them, connected and manual social icons, ordered link buttons, custom boxes (announcements, promos or info cards with or without a link and optional image), section headings, and optional per-page visual theme (surface, button shape, fill, colours, avatar and cover banner). Only what you send changes. By default the page takes its colours, fonts and logo from the saved brand and keeps the latest posts and the open-now line current by itself, so never add those as links. Hand over editorLink (/links) so the customer can preview and customize it visually anytime. Starter includes 1 page, Studio 10 and Pro 30; one more is refused. A handle someone else has is refused. With showBlog a page also carries the user’s blog: their articles, at the page’s address followed by /blog.

accountIds.description: The connected accounts this page shows as icons, and whose latest posts it shows, as ids from accounts_list, up to 150. Leave out to keep it as it is; null shows every connected account, which is how a new page starts.

addBox.description: One custom box (announcement, promo or info card, with or without a link) to add without sending the whole list. Goes first, under the top item.

body.description: Short text inside the custom box, up to 360 characters.

cta.description: Optional button label inside the box when url is set, up to 40 characters.

endsAt.description: Optional ISO date/time when this box stops showing publicly.

image.description: Optional workspace picture media id to show at the top of the box.

label.description: The custom box title, up to 80 characters.

layout.description: Optional box layout: "stack" (default), "compact" (side-by-side thumbnail), or "half" (2-column grid).

startsAt.description: Optional ISO date/time when this box starts showing publicly.

top.description: true highlights this box first and filled; any earlier top item stays ordinary.

url.description: Optional https:// web address, tel: phone number or mailto: email address for the box, up to 500 characters.

addLink.description: One link button to add without sending the whole list. It goes first, under the top item. Use it for "add my new video to my link page".

endsAt.description: Optional ISO date/time when this link stops showing publicly.

label.description: The words on the button, up to 60 characters.

layout.description: Optional button layout: "stack" (full width, default) or "half" (2-column grid item).

startsAt.description: Optional ISO date/time when this link starts showing publicly.

top.description: true makes it the top button; the item that was the top button stays as an ordinary item.

url.description: Where it leads: an https:// web address, a tel: phone number or a mailto: email address, up to 500 characters.

bio.description: One line about the business or the person, up to 160 characters. Empty text removes it.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

handle.description: The page’s address, after the @: 3 to 30 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example "casa-lola". Needed for a new page. Changing it moves the page: the old address stops working at once. If the page was ever public, the old address stays reserved for the user for 30 days: nobody else can take it, and they can move the page back.

hideBranding.description: true removes the “Made with Spica Post” line and generator tag from this link page, its blog and its media kit (Pro). Verified custom domains are always white-label.

id.description: A page id from links_list, to change that page. Leave out to make a new page.

links.description: Every link button, custom box and section heading, in the order shown, up to 30. This replaces the list, so send the items from links_list with your change made. To add one item without resending the list, use addLink or addBox.

body.description: For kind "box": short text inside the custom box (announcement, promo code, hours note, address, or details), up to 360 characters.

cta.description: For kind "box" with url: optional button text inside the box (up to 40 characters). Leave out to make the whole box clickable.

endsAt.description: Optional ISO date/time when this block stops showing publicly (must be after startsAt).

image.description: For kind "box": optional workspace picture media id to display at the top of the box.

kind.description: Block type: "link" for a link button (default), "box" for a custom announcement/promo/info card (works with or without a link), or "heading" for a section divider.

label.description: The button label (up to 60 characters), custom box title (up to 80 characters), or section heading (up to 60 characters).

layout.description: Card layout: "stack" (full width, default), "compact" (side-by-side thumbnail box), or "half" (2-column grid item).

shown.description: false keeps the item on the page’s list without showing it. Shown when left out.

startsAt.description: Optional ISO date/time when this block starts showing publicly (e.g. "2026-12-01T09:00:00Z").

top.description: true highlights this link or box as the top item: drawn first and filled. At most one item; not allowed on a heading.

url.description: Where a link button or clickable box leads: an https:// web address, a tel:+13055550100 phone number, or a mailto:name@example.com email address (up to 500 characters). Required for kind "link"; optional for kind "box"; omitted for kind "heading".

name.description: The name at the top of the page, up to 60 characters. The business name from the brand when left out.

published.description: true puts the page at its public address; false takes it down. A new page is not published until this is true. Ask the user before publishing.

showBlog.description: true makes this the page that carries the user’s blog: the articles put on the blog are public at this page’s address followed by /blog, and the page names the newest three. A workspace has one blog, so the page that had it gives it up and every article’s address changes. Off for a new page.

showHours.description: Whether the page says if the business is open now, from the opening hours on the brand. On for a new page; nothing is shown while the brand has no hours.

showPosts.description: Whether the page shows the latest published posts (up to three). On for a new page.

network.description: Which icon to draw in the top social row.

url.description: The profile or contact address: https://, tel: or mailto:, up to 500 characters.

socials.description: Manual social and contact icons shown in the top icon row alongside connected accounts (useful for LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Maps, Spotify or accounts not connected for posting), up to 12. Send null or [] to clear.

avatar.description: Optional workspace picture media id to override the brand logo on this page, or null to use the brand logo.

buttonFill.description: Style for ordinary link buttons: "outline" (default) or "solid" (softly filled).

buttons.description: Corner shape for link buttons and boxes: "pill" (default), "rounded", or "square".

ink.description: Optional text hex colour such as "#1A1A1A", or null to reset.

paper.description: Optional background hex colour such as "#FFFFFF", or null to reset.

primary.description: Optional accent hex colour such as "#0E4D3C", or null to reset.

colors.description: Optional per-page colour overrides. Send null to reset to the brand kit colours.

cover.description: Optional workspace picture media id for a header banner above the logo, or null to remove it.

font.description: Per-page font pairing: "brand" (brand kit fonts, default), "editorial" (Fraunces + Instrument Sans), "modern" (DM Sans), "bold" (Bricolage Grotesque + Inter), or "mono" (Space Grotesk + IBM Plex Mono).

surface.description: Page canvas style: "brand" (brand kit colours, default), "tint" (soft brand tint), "dark" (dark canvas), or "clean" (pure white).

theme.description: Optional per-page visual theme, colours and header photos. Leave out to keep as is; send null to reset to the brand default.

name: links_save
title: Save a link page
